subject: Discovery recap: Brightwell stakeholders, security roadmap & evidence schedule
body:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Alex Gonzalez <alex.gonzalez@brightwell.com>, Priya Singhal <priya.singhal@brightwell.com>, Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@brightwell.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-27T15:10:00-07:00
Subject: Discovery recap: Brightwell stakeholders, security roadmap & evidence schedule

Hi Alex / Priya / Maria —

Thanks again for a productive call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re aligned on the decision path and what evidence you need from Redwood to complete your security and procurement reviews.

Key stakeholders (as discussed)
- Economic buyer: Alex Gonzalez — CTO (final decision on budget / deployment model)
- Security owner: Priya Singhal — Head of InfoSec (controls, pen test, audit access)
- Procurement / Legal: Maria Lopez / procurement@brightwell.com (MSA, PO, commercial terms)
- Day-to-day evaluator / Eng sponsor: Javier Morales (we didn’t meet him today — if you’d like him on next call)

Decision criteria we heard
- Latency SLA for user-facing inference (p95 under 200ms for key endpoints)
- Clear audit logs and log retention policy for 24 months (hosted) and same guarantees for private deployment
- Data residency + encryption at rest with customer-managed keys (KMS)
- Predictable unit economics and a simple cost model for proof-of-concept -> production

Security evidence requested on the call (we’ll deliver the artifacts below)
- SOC 2 Type II report (summary + full report under NDA) — deliverable: Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_summary.pdf (attached)
- Penetration test executive summary and remediation timeline — deliverable: pen-test-exec-summary.pdf
- Architecture diagram showing network isolation, KMS integration, and audit-log paths — deliverable: redwood-arch-diagram.v1.png
- Data retention and deletion policy + sample retention config — deliverable: data-retention-policy-2028.pdf (we will share on follow-up)

Proposed next steps / owners (please confirm)
- Rishi to run a 60-min security deep-dive with Priya (cover infra, logging, KMS): propose Jul 2 or Jul 3 — owner: rishi_malhotra
- Ben to prepare a cost + MAP draft for the POC (3-week timeline) — owner: ben_carter
- Naomi to send MAP and SOC2 summary today, coordinate legal intro and HubSpot deal record — owner: naomi_feldman
- Monica to outline onboarding and CS touchpoints for post-sign (if we proceed) — owner: monica_patel

Attachments included: Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_summary.pdf

If this matches your expectations, I’ll schedule the security deep-dive and circulate the MAP (mutual action plan) with clear dates for evidence delivery and procurement milestones.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0182

From: Alex Gonzalez <alex.gonzalez@brightwell.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Singhal <priya.singhal@brightwell.com>, Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@brightwell.com>
Date: 2028-06-27T17:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Discovery recap: Brightwell stakeholders, security roadmap & evidence schedule

Naomi — thanks for the clear recap. A couple of quick clarifications: 

1) Log retention: when you say 24 months (hosted), can you confirm the retention policy applies to both application logs and raw audit logs? We need a separate statement for private deployments (on-prem/VPC) — is the retention configurable?
2) For the SOC2: can you provide the full Type II under NDA? We’ll need the full report for our legal review.
3) Timeline: our legal procurement window is tight. Maria is looped here — Maria, can you confirm target date for MSA review?

Also please include a short summary of how Redwood handles KMS and key rotation for customer-managed keys — we can review in the deep-dive.

— Alex
Alex Gonzalez | CTO, Brightwell Systems
alex.gonzalez@brightwell.com

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Priya Singhal <priya.singhal@brightwell.com>, Alex Gonzalez <alex.gonzalez@brightwell.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-28T09:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Discovery recap: Brightwell stakeholders, security roadmap & evidence schedule

Priya / Alex — Rishi here (security lead on the account). Thanks for the time yesterday. I can run the security deep-dive and walk through the following: network isolation, KMS integration and key rotation, audit-log streaming and retention options, SOC2 control mappings, and our pen-test scope and recent findings.

Proposed slots: Jul 2 10:00-11:00 PT or Jul 3 09:00-10:00 PT. Please pick one and I’ll send a calendar invite.

Attaching the pen-test executive summary and the architecture diagram for your review (see attachments). The pen-test doc contains the last cycle’s key findings and mitigations; happy to go deeper on any item during the call.

Attachments: pen-test-exec-summary.pdf; redwood-arch-diagram.v1.png

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Lead, Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.com

From: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@brightwell.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Alex Gonzalez <alex.gonzalez@brightwell.com>
Cc: procurement@brightwell.com, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-29T10:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Discovery recap: Brightwell stakeholders, security roadmap & evidence schedule

Naomi / team — thanks. From procurement/legal perspective we need a few items to start our internal timeline: 

- Draft MSA and any standard SOW (if you have a POC SOW template, please send)
- Pricing for a 3-week POC and an indicative production pricing band (GPU / token estimates acceptable)
- Expected timeline to provision a private deployment (if the POC needs to run in our VPC) and any on-prem prerequisites
- A copy of your PO template so we can validate fields before formal submission (I’m attaching ours for your reference)

We typically run legal review windows of ~10 business days once the MSA/SOW is in. If Redwood can provide a redlineable MSA this week, that helps accelerate.

Attached: Brightwell_PO_template.docx

Regards,
Maria Lopez
Head of Procurement | Brightwell Systems
maria.lopez@brightwell.com

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Alex Gonzalez <alex.gonzalez@brightwell.com>, Priya Singhal <priya.singhal@brightwell.com>, Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@brightwell.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-30T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Discovery recap: Brightwell stakeholders, security roadmap & evidence schedule

Appreciate the quick responses — consolidating next steps below and attaching the MAP.

Confirmed items / owners and dates
- SOC2 full report: available under NDA. Naomi to initiate NDA and deliver by EOD Jul 1 — owner: naomi_feldman. Attachment: Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_summary.pdf (summary included today).
- Security deep-dive: Jul 2 10:00 PT — owner: rishi_malhotra (calendar invite sent).
- Pen-test exec summary + architecture diagram: delivered (attached).
- POC MAP (3 weeks): draft attached (2028-MAP-Brightwell.xlsx). Ben to follow up with cost estimate by Jul 3 — owner: ben_carter.
- MSA / SOW: Naomi to circulate Redwood standard MSA and POC SOW template by Jul 1 for legal redline — owner: naomi_feldman.
- Procurement PO fields: we’ll review Brightwell_PO_template.docx and confirm — owner: naomi_feldman / monica_patel.

Deliverables attached to this thread:
- Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_summary.pdf
- pen-test-exec-summary.pdf
- redwood-arch-diagram.v1.png
- 2028-MAP-Brightwell.xlsx

If anything above is incorrect or you want different dates, flag now and we’ll adjust. Otherwise we’ll treat Jul 1–3 as the evidence & legal prep window and aim to have a POC kickoff scheduling conversation after the security deep-dive.

Thanks,
Naomi Feldman
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0182

----
[Attachment stubs in this thread are references only: full SOC2 and pen-test docs will be shared under NDA.]
